title: Category Manager: Sourcing plan
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: What requisitions are waiting, how should we buy each one, and who should we invite for the transformer order?

answer.question: What requisitions are waiting, how should we buy each one, and who should we invite for the transformer order?
answer.answer:
**Three requisitions are open:**

| Requisition | Item | Value | Need by | Recommended route |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-7712 | 500 kVA distribution transformers (×24) | $672,000 | 5 Mar 2027 | Mini-competition under framework FW-DT-22 |
| REQ-7710 | 33 kV XLPE cable, 6 km | $1,380,000 | 8 Apr 2027 | Open tender |
| REQ-7715 | 11 kV pole-top fuse kits (×400) | $38,000 | 14 Dec 2026 | Direct award under framework FW-OH-19 |

**Transformer order (REQ-7712):** Invite these three suppliers from FW-DT-22:
- **Brightwater Transformers**: 97% on-time in full, no open nonconformances
- **Halden Transformer Works**: 94% on-time in full, no open nonconformances
- **Kelso Electrical Supply**: 92% on-time in full, one minor open nonconformance

Don't invite **Marlow Power Products**. It's below the 90% on-time threshold and has an open major nonconformance (oil leaks).

The mini-competition is needed because the order is above the $250,000 direct-award limit. Nothing has been issued yet. The category manager needs to confirm the route and shortlist before the RFQ goes out in the supplier portal.
